name: Barbell Snatch
steps: Stand with a barbell over your midfoot, bend your hips and knees with a flat back, and take a wide overhand snatch grip.
Push through your feet to lift the bar close to your legs, then extend your hips, knees, and ankles explosively at your upper thighs.
Pull yourself rapidly under the rising bar into a full squat, punching both arms locked straight overhead.
Stand tall from the squat with the bar balanced overhead, then lower it safely back to the floor.
tips: Keep the bar traveling close to your body throughout the pull and turnover.
Lock your elbows completely overhead and stabilize your balance before standing from the catch.
